scope: Local production Main/Board browser replay and headless stability; no live service or human data

methodology.animationTiming: Production BoardRenderer normal waits, virtual 16ms ticks; timer also runs during cascades
methodology.statistics: Wilson 95% interval per cell; chi-square df=2 for 3 batches when all expected counts >=5; familywise alpha .01/81, sparse cells descriptive only
methodology.clocks: First move completes before timer begins; thinking before later swaps can time out; no global Math.random replacement
limitations: Same production rule engine, integration equivalence rather than independent rules proof
Virtual animation waits, no WeChat device frame timing
Synthetic policies, not calibrated human players
Finite representative levels, not every level
